page_header.intro: Say who you are, clearly and consistently, in a way your audiences understand.

overview.heading: What it is
overview.text:
A brand is more than a logo. It is what people understand about you, and why they choose you over someone else. When that understanding is fuzzy, every piece of communication has to work harder.

We help you define your purpose and values, decide where you stand, and turn that into messages and a tone of voice that your team can use with confidence.

items.title: Purpose and values
items.text: Why you exist and what you stand for, written in words people will remember.

items.title: Positioning
items.text: Who you serve, what makes you different and the point of view you want to be known for.

items.title: Messaging
items.text: Key messages for each audience, so everyone tells the same story.

items.title: Tone of voice
items.text: Practical guidance on how you sound, with examples your team can follow.

items.question: Do we need a new logo?
items.answer: Not always. We look at what you have first, and only recommend design changes where they help people understand you better.

items.question: Can you work with our existing designers?
items.answer: Yes. We often hand our work to an in-house or external design team, and stay involved to make sure the thinking carries through.

cta.heading: Want people to understand you better?
cta.text: We are always happy to have an informal conversation about your brand.
